status.shortComment: Banks (calf) was a limited participant at practice Thursday, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.
status.longComment: Per Pat Leonard of the New York Daily News, Banks was working off to the side with trainers Thursday. It's not clear when he sustained the calf injury, but it doesn't look like it's anything too severe. If he's able to manage a full practice Friday, he could still avoid carrying an injury designation into the weekend.
